title: Get Reporting Status Request
x-tool-summary: Check reporting health, enumerate expected periods and all retained revisions, or resolve one exact reporting revision.
description: Authoritative reporting reliability read. The explicit view discriminator prevents filters from changing response shape implicitly. summary answers the operational question; periods returns a cursor-paginated obligation ledger; revision resolves one exact retained revision and its materializations/resources. Sellers implementing this task MUST advertise media_buy.reporting_delivery in experimental_features.

account.description: Account whose caller-owned reporting status is queried.

view.description: Stable response-shape discriminator. SDK convenience methods may default this to summary, but the wire request is explicit.

media_buy_ids.description: Optional summary/periods scope. Omit for every accessible media buy in the account.

period.description: Half-open summary/periods horizon. Omit for the seller's documented operational default horizon; the response always echoes the evaluated scope.

health.description: Periods-view filter. Summary implementations MAY use it only to narrow the evaluated obligation set and MUST echo that scope.

reporting_revision_id.description: Exact retained revision to resolve in revision view.

pagination.description: Periods-view pagination only. The cursor orders obligations and revisions without assuming append-only reporting rows.
